expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

files.body:
The planned v2 work will expand the protocol beyond the current ping-only message with additional message types, clearer encoding and decoding rules, improved error handling, and compatibility considerations for future clients; it will also add focused tests and documentation so the evolving wire format remains predictable and maintainable.

Shipped in v2: added `Msg::Hello(String)` using the explicit `v:2` envelope while preserving the existing ping message path.
